scope: Actual components with simulated IPC; native feature tests run separately
checks: Markdown reading position returns after switching documents, without animating or recreating the whole workspace
Tab context menu pins, bulk close preserves pinned tabs, Ctrl+Shift+T reopens and drag order/pins persist
Tag right-click pins frequently used tags and changes library-scoped ordering
Collections reorder through their menu, save multiple required tags and remember result sorting after returning
Relations appear directly beside any file; edit type/description in a modal, retaining input on failure and updating the list after retry
TXT history compares, protects drafts before replacement, keeps replacement unsaved and creates a .txt recovery copy without changing the source
At 760px, open the responsive navigation before using its create menu; all six styles keep this interaction usable
